shots.focal_element: Kinetic caption 'We needed to RETHINK' over a man working at an iMac, seen in profile at a desk against a pink wall
shots.typography: Bold rounded geometric sans, sentence case, tight tracking, white, stacked over two lines in the upper-centre; the key word 'RETHINK' switches to all-caps in a gradient fill and reveals letter by letter. Font guess (low confidence): Plus Jakarta Sans or similar.
shots.what_happens: Live-action office footage with a fairly static camera. Captions keep pace with the voice-over (w93-w96): 'We needed to' appears first, then 'RETHINK' builds on in gradient caps beside 'to'. A small ClickUp watermark sits bottom-right.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a full-bleed footage clip, place a white bold two-line caption top-centre and reveal each word at its transcript start time, then wipe in the key word letter by letter in uppercase with a horizontal gradient fill.

shots.focal_element: Top-down shot of hands typing on a mechanical keyboard on a ClickUp desk mat, with the caption 'How software was built' typing on above it
shots.typography: Bold rounded geometric sans, sentence case, white, a single line left of centre; revealed character by character like a typewriter ('How soft', then 'How software was b').
shots.what_happens: Overhead B-roll of hands typing. The caption types on character by character in sync with w97-w100, so the visible typing echoes the hands on the keyboard. The final sheet frame (0:33.500) already shows the glasses close-up from s022, which looks like a sampling edge at the cut.
shots.build_rebuild: Over an overhead footage clip, type a white bold caption on one character per frame-step so that each word lands on its transcript time.

shots.focal_element: The word 'ENTIRELY.' on the left third, set against an extreme close-up of the man's face and glasses filling the right two-thirds
shots.typography: All-caps semi-bold sans with slightly condensed, squarer letterforms and normal tracking, in off-white. This looks like a different face from the rounded captions elsewhere; I could not identify it (low confidence).
shots.what_happens: A short punch-in to an extreme close-up of the face in glasses, with the background dark and soft. A single uppercase word lands on w101 to close the sentence. Only one sheet frame is available, so I cannot tell how the word enters.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to an extreme close-up framed to the right and set one uppercase word left-centre for the whole shot, starting on the word's transcript time.

shots.focal_element: An isometric 3D platform slab that gains four glowing product tiles (Chat, Project Management, AI, Knowledge Management) and then merges into one gradient ClickUp slab
shots.typography: Two type tiers. Word-by-word captions in a white bold rounded geometric sans, sentence case, placed at scattered positions (lower-centre, top-left, side columns). Keywords ('PROBLEM,', 'POWERFUL PRIMITIVES') are set huge in all-caps with a horizontal gradient fill and outer glow, sitting behind the 3D object. 'MULTIPLE' is all-caps with heavy motion blur. The closing captions are stacked centred lines on black. The tile labels are tiny, rotated to the isometric plane.
shots.what_happens: Within one shot (9.3 s, w102-w130): the presenter, filmed against black, speaks while captions build ('To solve the', 'Root of the'). A gradient 'PROBLEM,' rises behind him and then fades as a dark isometric slab replaces him. 'we built a single' and 'flexible' sit either side of the slab. Four coloured tiles drop onto it one after another. 'POWERFUL' and then 'PRIMITIVES' fill the background in giant gradient caps. The tiles merge into a single gradient slab carrying the ClickUp mark ('that can be shared to'), which pushes in while 'MULTIPLE' blurs past. The shot ends on black with stacked centred kinetic captions 'first class products' and 'inside of one'. Anchors report 1 event.
shots.build_rebuild: Build an isometric rounded-box mesh with an emissive edge glow, drop four labelled coloured tiles onto it with a staggered ease-out, then morph them into one gradient top face with the logo. Behind it, put giant gradient uppercase keywords; in front, place word-timed white captions.

shots.focal_element: The word 'CONVERGENCE' in a glowing gradient, centred after the ClickUp logomark badge resolves, followed by a scrolling glowing timeline that sprouts app icons
shots.typography: White bold rounded geometric sans in sentence case, with tight tracking and words entering one at a time. Hero words ('CONVERGENCE', 'NEW WAY') are all-caps with a multicolour horizontal gradient and a soft outer glow; 'NEW WAY' is set huge behind the presenter. In 'deliver / products' the two words are stacked small either side of a white bar. The final caption 'everything we've built has' is a right-aligned stack on the left of frame.
shots.what_happens: Long kinetic sequence (11.5 s, w132-w165). The ClickUp logomark badge appears centred on black, and 'we call this' builds under it. A cut to 'CONVERGENCE' in gradient follows, then a small dot turns into a white bar as 'it's allowed us to deliver products' slides left with motion blur. The bar becomes a glowing horizontal timeline whose stems sprout app icons while the camera pans left (calendar '31' icon at the end). The presenter on black then fades up behind 'and' / 'now'; 'we're tying it all together in a' builds in the corners and a giant gradient 'NEW WAY' appears behind him. A left-side stack 'everything we've built has' then 'led to' closes the shot. Anchors report 2 events.
shots.build_rebuild: On a black canvas, chain word-timed captions: scale in a logo badge, crossfade to a gradient glowing keyword, then extend a white rounded bar from a dot into a timeline that pans left (motion blur) and pops icon stems on alternate sides, before fading in presenter footage behind large gradient caps.
